title: 634-The Consequences of State Collapse (Devlet Çöküşünün Sonuçları)

sentences.englishText: When states collapse, they not only become havens for terrorists and drug smugglers but also prompt multitudes of refugees to head for richer countries.
sentences.turkishText: Devletler çökünce, sadece teröristlere ve uyuşturucu kaçakçılarına sığınak olmaz, aynı zamanda mülteci yığınlarının zengin ülkelere yönelmesini teşvik ederler.

sentences.englishText: Furthermore, rebellions increase and it becomes an attraction center for the states which have made a plan to exploit that state.
sentences.turkishText: Bunun yanı sıra isyanlar artar ve o devleti sömürmek için plan yapan devletlerin cazibe merkezi haline gelebilir.

sentences.englishText: For this reason, the consciousness of being a nation must be given from early ages to the young generation.
sentences.turkishText: Bu sebepten ötürü genç nesillere millet olma bilinci küçük yaşlardan itibaren verilmelidir.

enrichment.summary: When states collapse, they not only become havens for terrorists and drug smugglers but also prompt multitudes of refugees to head for richer countries. Furthermore, rebellions increase and it becomes an attraction center for the states which have made a plan to exploit that state.
